criteria.requirement: The furnished 3D balcony includes solid side wall, railing and overhang with visible, geometrically plausible shadows.
criteria.action: Inspect the furnished balcony and scrub the daylight controls.
criteria.expected: The solid wall, railing and overhang cast visible shadows consistent with their positions.

criteria.requirement: Compass orientation, sample location and date can be changed, and daylight scrubbing changes the sun/shade result.
criteria.action: Change compass orientation, sample location and date, then scrub daylight hours.
criteria.expected: The selected values update and the sun/shade result changes coherently.

criteria.requirement: Planters can be moved in top view and their shaded versus sunlit state can be inspected.
criteria.action: Switch to top view, move a planter and inspect its shade at a fixed time.
criteria.expected: The planter moves to the chosen position and its sunlit or shaded condition is inspectable.

criteria.requirement: Two different planter arrangements can be compared at the same time of day.
criteria.action: Create two arrangements and compare them at the same selected time.
criteria.expected: Both layouts are distinguishable and the comparison uses the same time of day.

criteria.requirement: The simplified solar assumptions are visible and the demo works without location permission or an API key.
criteria.action: Open the app without granting location access; inspect model assumptions.
criteria.expected: Bundled sample locations permit immediate use without an API key, with simplified solar assumptions disclosed.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect furnished balcony geometry, actual shadows, initial planters and documented solar assumptions.
Change location/date/orientation and daylight time, then move a planter from top view.
Save one arrangement, change the other and compare under identical sunlight; reverse time and revisit a saved arrangement.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
